In BJ skin fibroblasts undergoing oncogene-induced senescence (RAF) at 1d post-senescence induction, treatment with compoundA (targeting RELA) at dose 2uM_2h is applied. </question>
<options>

</options>
<experiment>

</experiment>
<gene_context>
In this experiment, knocked down gene(s): RELA.
</gene_context>
rows.follow_up: Gene: GNG11 (G protein subunit gamma 11). Log2FC=-536.1259, p=4.60e-07. Significance threshold: |Log2FC| > 1.0, pval < 0.05. GEO accession: GSE134747. According to CellAge, GNG11 induces cellular senescence (senescence type: Stress-induced). CellAge PMID: 17092487.

In a senescence perturbation experiment using IMR-90 lung fibroblasts undergoing oncogene-induced senescence (RAS) at 7d post-senescence induction, shRNA knockdown of p53 is applied. Compared to untreated DNA damage-induced senescent cells, consider the following two genes measured by microarray:

Gene A: PPM1D (protein phosphatase, Mg2+/Mn2+ dependent 1D)
Gene B: TNFSF15 (TNF superfamily member 15)

Which gene shows a larger absolute change in mRNA expression (|Log2FC|)?
</question>
<options>
A. Gene A shows a larger absolute change B. Gene B shows a larger absolute change
</options>
<experiment>
Cell line: IMR-90 lung fibroblasts. Senescence model: oncogene-induced senescence (RAS). Perturbation: shRNA knockdown of p53. Control condition: untreated DNA damage-induced senescent cells. Biological replicates: 3. Differential expression analysis: Limma.
</experiment>
<gene_context>
In this experiment, knocked down gene(s): p53.
</gene_context>
rows.follow_up: Gene A: PPM1D (protein phosphatase, Mg2+/Mn2+ dependent 1D), Log2FC=-1.1249, p=3.37e-18. Gene B: TNFSF15 (TNF superfamily member 15), Log2FC=1.6411, p=2.59e-19. |Log2FC_A|=1.1249, |Log2FC_B|=1.6411. GEO accession: GSE53379.
